_notes: Commissary garages (design: Commissary and new foods). Keys starting with an underscore are notes; the loader ignores them.
_commissaries: Each is a garage in an industrial or mixed block, picked from tools/balance/city.json. A new game gives random AI shops to retail and office units and a rival's factory to a few random warehouses, and never a business to a home (the game's CityGenerator, 1.0). So a commissary is a warehouse, or a residential building where the neighbourhood has no warehouse: Hell's Kitchen's is First Street 22, by the wholesaler at First Street 18 (10 October 2026; First Street 24, a retail unit, held a liquor store in one game and a nightclub in another). A rival factory can still land in one of the warehouses; the log says so at load, and the bay works the same. Changing an address is safe for saves: they keep only the id. id is lower-case letters, digits and dashes and is part of the commissary's phone contact (foodtrucks-commissary-<id>, which en.json names). name is a locale key. address is street#number. The loading bay is the nearest legal parking (the game's own wheel test) to the building's nearest entrance, searched up to 30 m out; a vehicle within rules.json's commissary.bayRadiusMetres of it and on the door's side of the street stands in the bay. The bay is on the door's side of the street (Peter, 13 October 2026): a place counts only when the straight walk from the entrance to it crosses no driving lane (Core BaySide). An optional bay {x, z} (world metres, as the zone point key Ctrl+Alt+G logs them) starts that search at a measured point instead, for a garage whose entrance has no parking within a short walk; the point must pass the same side rule from the nearest entrance, or the log says so and it isn't used. Hell's Kitchen's measured bay (x 393.2, z 217.6, on the far kerb across its one-way street from the door at x 404.5, z 228.4) went for that reason. Garment District's (x 305.7, z -311.6) and Murray Hill's (x 43.8, z -281.8) were measured with the test bridge's bay_candidates and a truck teleported there, legal with the hatch to the pavement (live session 4, 13 October 2026): both doors are cut off from the street's NavMesh, so the automatic search takes nothing from them. Industry City has no bay: its street has no parking lanes within 80 m, so it moves to another garage. Every commissary ships with a bay on its door's side (Peter, 13 October 2026; candidates for Industry City and Hell's Kitchen in docs/implementation-plan.md, Bays on the door's side). Positions are approximate until checked in game.
